cases.question: Compare vessel wave height by minute over the last 7 days

card.sql:
-- Logical query. Execution streams its first complete time bucket,
-- then the remaining buckets in one read-only DuckDB snapshot.
SELECT (floor(t / 60000) * 60000)::DOUBLE AS x,
       avg(wave_height)::DOUBLE AS y, vessel::INTEGER AS series,
       avg(lat)::DOUBLE AS lat, avg(lon)::DOUBLE AS lon
FROM telemetry
WHERE t >= 1788825600000 AND t < 1789430400000
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1, 3
